task_description: Build Milestone 1 of the ADX compiler: a TypeScript/Node npm package in compiler/ that compiles one .adx component directory into complete static HTML + plain CSS + a hydration-only ES-module glue script, with an `adx build` / `adx check` CLI, plus design tokens, a UserCard fixture, and synced docs. Static-HTML-first for SEO; token-efficient and AI-friendly by design.
